signals.summary: Kaseya cut 5 percent of its global workforce, about 250 employees, redesigning its go-to-market approach and customer segmentation.
Kaseya confirmed 200 layoffs as part of a "focused investment strategy," while saying it would keep hiring in customer-facing, product and engineering roles.
CEO Rania Succar announced Kaseya acquired AI-based email security provider Inky.
Kaseya cites a very strong end to 2025 and continued investment in customer value while transforming IT and security for SMBs.
Company says significant incremental R&D investments over the past year yielded stronger product quality and faster innovation velocity.
